description: turboserve gateway: SLO overview, rollout lanes and per-tenant attribution. Every panel reads the Prometheus metrics the gateway exposes on /metrics.

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: Requests completed per second across every selected tenant and lane.

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Failed requests over all requests. The red threshold is the canary gate (canary.max_error_rate) and the same number deploy/prometheus/rules.yaml alerts on.

panels.title: TTFT p95
panels.description: 95th percentile time to first token, from the gateway's histogram.

panels.title: TPOT p95
panels.description: 95th percentile time per output token after the first.

panels.title: Spend $/h
panels.description: Attributed spend per hour, derived from the configured per-token prices in configs/models.yaml. Configured prices, not an invoice.

panels.title: Requests/s by status
panels.description: Outcome mix. `ok` plus every error class the gateway reports.

panels.title: Time to first token
panels.description: Prefix-cache hits show up here first: a hit removes prefill work from the critical path before the first token.

panels.title: Time per output token
panels.description: Decode-phase slope. Speculative decoding and batch pressure both move this line.

panels.title: TTFT p95 by lane
panels.description: The canary controller compares exactly these two series; max_p95_ratio_vs_stable is evaluated on their ratio.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, lane) (rate(turboserve_gateway_ttft_seconds_bucket{tenant=~"$tenant", model=~"$model", lane=~"$lane"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Canary TTFT p95 / stable TTFT p95
panels.description: Above the dashed line the canary is slower than stable by more than the gate allows and the controller rolls back.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(turboserve_gateway_ttft_seconds_bucket{tenant=~"$tenant", model=~"$model", lane="canary"}[$__rate_interval]))) / on() group_left() histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(turboserve_gateway_ttft_seconds_bucket{tenant=~"$tenant", model=~"$model", lane="stable"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Error ratio by lane
panels.description: Per-lane failure ratio; the dashed line is the canary gate.

targets.expr: sum by (lane) (rate(turboserve_gateway_requests_total{tenant=~"$tenant", model=~"$model", lane=~"$lane", status="error"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (lane) (rate(turboserve_gateway_requests_total{tenant=~"$tenant", model=~"$model", lane=~"$lane"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Queue depth by model
panels.description: Requests admitted and waiting on a backend. This is the series the gateway HPA scales on (Pods metric turboserve_gateway_queue_depth).

panels.title: Rate-limited requests/s by tenant
panels.description: 429s from the per-tenant quotas, split by which quota refused them. A tenant pinned here needs a quota change, not more replicas.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (tenant) (rate(turboserve_gateway_tokens_total{tenant=~"$tenant", model=~"$model", lane=~"$lane", kind="completion"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Attributed spend $/h by tenant
panels.description: Cost attribution from configured prices; use it for chargeback ratios, not for billing.

panels.title: Requests/s by backend
panels.description: Routing split across the pool behind the selected model.

panels.title: Backend health
panels.description: Last health probe per backend in the pool: 1 healthy, 0 not. A backend at 0 is removed from routing, so a drop here should not move the error ratio.

panels.title: Canary weight
panels.description: Share of traffic the router is currently sending to the canary lane, as the controller sees it. Step changes here should line up with the lane panels above.

panels.title: Prompt vs completion tokens/s
panels.description: Prefill versus decode pressure; the ratio decides whether the cluster is compute-bound or bandwidth-bound.
